criteria.description: The match starts normally with one keep, three workers, readable resources, and usable camera control.
Click/tap and desktop box selection, visible selected state, camera navigation, and move, gather, build, and attack commands produce immediate readable acknowledgement.
Workers visibly travel to wood or ore, gather a limited load, return to deposit it, and resume work; resources cannot increase without those steps.
Barracks placement validates grid, blockers, units, boundaries, and affordability, then construction and a paid timed queue produce soldiers.
Units acquire targets, move, attack on cooldown, take damage, die, and can repel a readable timed enemy raid before assaulting defended enemy structures.
Selected units navigate around static blockers and each other without permanent clumping, illegal destinations, or unexplained teleportation.
Destroying the enemy keep after genuine gathering, barracks construction, and soldier production wins; losing the player keep fails; restart returns to a clean match.
At 390 x 844 selection, camera, move/attack, gather, build, and production remain usable without right-click, hover, or critical UI overlap.
